summary: Tested admin journey edit form (JourneyEditForm component) for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. Fixed critical bug where 'token' was undefined in Admin.js. All 7 backend tests passed. All frontend features working: 4 tabs (Basico/Conteudo/Storytelling/Configuracoes), real-time preview, unsaved changes indicator, inline validation, AI storytelling generation button.

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: token is not defined - caused admin edit form to crash
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'token' to destructured variables from useAuth() hook: const { user, loading: authLoading, getAuthHeaders, token } = useAuth();

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/admin/generate-story-chapters returns 400 when journey_name missing
Backend: POST /api/admin/generate-story-chapters with valid data returns chapters
Frontend: Admin login works with admin@4luis.com / Admin1
Frontend: JourneyEditForm opens when clicking pencil edit button
Frontend: Basico fields: edit-name, edit-poetic-name, edit-goal, edit-target-date, edit-image-url
Frontend: Conteudo fields: edit-emotional, edit-impact, edit-description
Frontend: Story chapter title/text fields for chapters 1-5
Frontend: 'Gerar Storytelling com IA' button visible (data-testid='generate-ai-story-btn')
Frontend: Unsaved indicator shows 'Alteracoes por guardar' (data-testid='unsaved-indicator')
Frontend: Form closes when Cancel clicked
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyEditForm.js is well-structured with 4 tabs, proper state management, and data-testid attributes for testing
AI story generation endpoint POST /api/admin/generate-story-chapters uses emergentintegrations LLM with gpt-5.2 model
Real-time preview uses memoized comparison to detect unsaved changes: const hasChanges = JSON.stringify(form) !== originalJson
Inline validation for required fields (name, goal_amount >= 100) with visual error states
seed_data_creation: None needed - used existing China journey
context_for_next_testing_agent: JourneyEditForm fully tested and working. Key data-testids: journey-edit-form (main container), tab-basico/conteudo/storytelling/config (tabs), edit-name/poetic-name/goal/target-date/image-url (basico fields), edit-emotional/impact/description (conteudo), story-chapter-title-{1-5}/story-chapter-text-{1-5} (storytelling), generate-ai-story-btn (AI button), toggle-preview-btn (preview), unsaved-indicator, edit-save-btn/edit-cancel-btn. Bug fix applied: Added 'token' to useAuth() destructuring in Admin.js line 14.
